About CALHN
At Central Adelaide (CALHN), we're shaping the future of health through excellence in clinical care, research, and innovation. As South Australia's largest health network, we deliver exceptional, safe and connected healthcare - for our patients, our community, and our people.

With more than 17,000 dedicated employees, every day at CALHN presents an opportunity to make a real impact-not because it's expected, but because our values guide us to be our best. Find out more about CALHN sites and services, our stories and the opportunities to be part of CALHN.

About the Role

Play a key role in supporting clinicians and helping deliver safe, high quality care. As a Senior Support Services Officer, you'll coordinate essential support services, guide daily operations and help create a welcoming, efficient environment for patients, visitors and staff.

- Lead daily support service delivery across clinical areas
- Support clinicians with safe, efficient patient care
- Build positive relationships with staff, patients and visitors
- Maintain smooth ward operations and service standards
- Respond to changing priorities as part of a multidisciplinary team

About You

You'll bring experience, sound judgement and a genuine commitment to supporting safe, person centred care in a busy healthcare environment.

- AQF Certificate III relevant to the role
- Experience in a healthcare support services environment
- Confident leading, guiding and supporting team members
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Able to prioritise work and respond calmly under pressure

Why You'll Love It Here - CALHN benefits that matter
We know that a great career is about more than just the work you do, it's also about the support you receive. At CALHN, you'll enjoy :

Salary packaging - up to $9,010 for living expenses + $2,650 for meals & entertainment + pre-tax super & novated lease options

Diversity & Inclusion

result.description:
The Client: 

Telelink Pty Ltd is an Australian provider of advanced telecommunications solutions, specialising in offering innovative and reliable telecommunications services.  

They now seek a skilled and qualified Telecommunication Lines Worker to join their team in Lutana in TAS on a full time basis.  

 

 

The Role: 

This is for a full time position with an annual salary between $80,000 to $85,000 depending on experience plus superannuation. The role will be based in Lutana in TAS. 

 

? 

The Responsibilities: 

Reviewing blueprints, schematics, and specifications for equipment installations and understanding where and how the equipment (loopaline, jdsu linester, fiber meter, pon meter, lockout kit, gas detector, video probe, harnsess & ladders) will be positioned and connected to ensure correct installation and functionality. 

Using various instruments such as ohmmeters, voltmeters, ammeters, and transmission measuring equipment to detect faults or malfunctions in telecommunications systems. This involves diagnosing issues in wiring, equipment, or signal transmission. 

Connecting wiring and cables to different appliances or equipment. This involves proper handling of wires to ensure secure and safe connections for functionality. 

Adjusting, replacing, or repairing the faulty components. Also, testing the equipment using electronic instruments to ensure it functions correctly. 

Installing various types of cabling systems for telecommunications, including those used for telephones, radio broadcasts, pay TV, and internet transmission. This involves both physical installation and ensuring proper signal flow. This involves connecting cables together securely and sealing the cable sheaths using lead or thermoplastic materials to ensure the integrity of the connection, especially in outdoor or harsh environments. 

Installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting both aerial (above-ground) and underground wiring systems for various telecommunications services. This includes erecting antennas for radio and mobile phone communication and ensuring they perform optimal 

Installing telecommunication devices like telephones, switchboards, and data transmission equipment and ensures these devices are set up correctly and are functioning according to specifications. 

 

 

The Requirements: 

At least a Diploma qualification in Telecommunications or a related field 

At least 2 years full time post qualification experience as a Telecommunications Lines Worker  

At least 2 years’ experience installing, maintaining, testing, and fault finding telecommunications copper, fibre, aerial, underground, and customer premises cabling systems 

At least 2 years’ experience using telecommunications testing equipment including Loopaline, JDSU line tester, fibre meter, PON meter, ohmmeters, voltmeters, ammeters, and transmission measuring instruments 

At least 2 years’ experience diagnosing signal loss, cable faults, wiring defects, equipment malfunction, poor transmission quality, and connectivity failures across telecommunications networks 

At least 2 years’ experience terminating, jointing, sealing, repairing, and securing telecommunications cables, including lead or thermoplastic sheath sealing for outdoor and underground cable integrity 

At least 2 years’ experience installing and commissioning telecommunication devices, antennas, switchboards, data transmission equipment, internet cabling, pay TV cabling, and telephone systems 

Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to perform on-site analysis and resolution of technical problems 

Ability to work independently and as part of a team 

Familiarity with maintaining detailed logs and documentation of inventories, parts, equipment, and instruments, as well as communication policies and procedures 

Ability to liaise effectively with vendors, suppliers, service providers, and external resources to monitor contractual obligations and performance delivery

result.description: OMNI PACKAGING PTY LTD   JOB DESCRIPTION      As an Electronics Trades Worker at Omni Packaging Pty Ltd, you will be responsible for the installation, testing, maintenance, and repair of electronic and communication equipment used in packaging operations and industrial processes. The role involves working closely with technical teams to ensure equipment operates efficiently and reliably, identifying and troubleshooting faults, and carrying out timely repairs to minimize downtime. You will ensure all systems comply with safety standards and operational requirements, while supporting continuous improvement by assisting in the upgrade and optimisation of existing equipment. Your role will be key in maintaining smooth production flow and supporting the overall performance of electronic systems within the organisation.      DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES     Setting up and installing machinery, providing troubleshooting support to technicians & customers,   Work in a professional and safe manner at all time and maintain all relevant OH&S requirements      Maintaining and repairing parts systems, providing pro-active servicing to customers offsite & ensuring all machinery in house is in full working order. # Motor Mechanic

## About Gold Coast Car Electrics & Mechanical

Gold Coast Car Electrics & Mechanical is a trusted independent automotive workshop committed to delivering high-quality mechanical repairs, servicing and diagnostic solutions. We service a wide range of petrol, diesel and hybrid vehicles, combining advanced diagnostic technology with skilled workmanship to ensure our customers' vehicles remain safe, reliable and performing at their best.

We are seeking a qualified and motivated **Motor Mechanic** to join our growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who takes pride in their workmanship, enjoys solving technical problems and values delivering outstanding customer service.

## Key Responsibilities

As a Motor Mechanic, you will be responsible for:

* Diagnosing mechanical faults using diagnostic equipment and technical expertise.
* Performing servicing, maintenance and repairs on petrol, diesel and hybrid vehicles in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
* Inspecting engines, transmissions, suspension, steering, braking and cooling systems to identify faults and determine repair requirements.
* Removing, dismantling, repairing and replacing worn or defective mechanical components.
* Carrying out engine tuning, timing adjustments and performance-related repairs to ensure optimum vehicle operation.
* Inspecting and repairing driveline components, clutches, gearboxes, differentials and exhaust systems.
* Completing scheduled logbook servicing, preventative maintenance and vehicle safety inspections.
* Testing vehicles before and after repairs to verify that faults have been rectified and the vehicle is safe and roadworthy.
* Maintaining accurate service records and clearly communicating repair recommendations to customers and the service team.
* Ensuring all work is completed efficiently while complying with workplace health and safety requirements and industry standards.
* Maintaining a clean, organised and safe workshop environment, including the proper care of tools and equipment.

## Essential Qualifications and Experience

* AQF Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology (or equivalent) with at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV. Alternatively, a minimum of three years of relevant industry experience.
* At least two years' experience as a qualified Motor Mechanic is preferred.
* Current Australian driver's licence (preferred).

## Skills and Attributes

The successful applicant will demonstrate:

* Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills across a wide range of vehicle makes and models.
* Sound knowledge of automotive mechanical systems and manufacturer repair procedures.
* Experience using modern diagnostic scan tools and workshop equipment.
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Good organisational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritise workloads.
* The ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* A strong commitment to quality workmanship, workplace safety and customer satisfaction.

## Employment Details

* **Position:** Permanent Full-Time
* **Salary:** AU$80,000 per annum plus employer superannuation contributions at the statutory rate.
* **Location:** Ashmore, Gold Coast, Queensland
* **Job Type:** Full-time
